fullPassage: Modern Thai boxing, as practiced in the two major stadiums in Bangkok, is something to behold. The golden era of Thai boxing started around the late 1970s and continued into the early 1990s. This was when the sport took a giant leap into modernity. In the matches, light gloves are worn, and kicking is permitted. There are typically 10 fights per night, each of which lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of whom are males, but many other people stand outside and follow the action intently by radio or, in some cases, television. Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual indicating the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained. An Asian band plays throughout each round, but slowly in the first two rounds. In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus exciting the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly and begin to place bets through the use of hand movements.

③ Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of them are males.
④ An Asian band plays throughout each round.

questions.passage: Modern Thai boxing, as practiced in the two major stadiums in Bangkok, is something to behold. The golden era of Thai boxing started around the late 1970s and continued into the early 1990s. This was when the sport took a giant leap into modernity. In the matches, light gloves are worn, and __________ is permitted. There are typically 10 fights per night, each of which lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of whom are males, but many other people stand outside and follow the action intently by radio or, in some cases, television. Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual indicating the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained. An Asian band plays throughout each round, but slowly in the first two rounds. In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus exciting the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly and begin to place bets through the use of hand movements.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어, -ing 형태)

det.analysis: 원문 'kicking is permitted'에서 kicking이 정답. -ing 형태 동명사가 주어. 타이 복싱의 독특한 특징.
det.tip: kicking(발차기) — 동명사로 주어 역할. Muay Thai는 발차기 허용 킥복싱.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 방콕의 현대 타이 복싱 경기장 분위기와 특징.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 방콕의 현대 타이 복싱 경기장의 특징과 분위기: 경기 규칙, 관중, 의식, 밴드, 베팅 등 경기장 풍경 전반을 묘사.
❌ ② 타이 복싱 챔피언의 훈련 방법: 훈련법은 본문 주제 아님.
❌ ③ 방콕 관광 산업의 발전: 관광업은 본문 없음.
❌ ④ 동남아시아 스포츠의 역사적 기원: 기원사는 본문 없음.
det.tip: 주제 = 본문 전체의 핵심. '방콕 타이 복싱 경기장의 현장 풍경'이 중심.

questions.stem: 위 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 방콕의 타이 복싱은 규칙, 전통 의식, 음악, 관중 참여가 어우러진 독특한 문화 경험이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② In Bangkok's stadiums, modern Thai boxing combines unique rules, pre-fight rituals, live music, and passionate crowd participation into a distinctive cultural experience.: 본문의 모든 요소(규칙/의식/밴드/관중)를 포괄한 요약.
❌ ① Thai boxing is a silent indoor sport enjoyed by a small group of experts: '조용하다', '소수 전문가'는 흥분한 군중 묘사와 모순.
❌ ③ Thai boxing originated in Europe before spreading to Asia in the 1990s: 유럽 기원은 본문에 없고 사실도 아님.
❌ ④ Modern Thai boxing matches are held outdoors and last for several hours each: 실내 경기장, 경기 길이도 본문과 다름.
det.tip: 요약 = 규칙 + 의식 + 음악 + 관중 = 독특한 문화 경험.
